detail.overview: When his car breaks down, a quiet loner agrees to clean an abandoned family fun center in exchange for repairs. He soon finds himself waging war against possessed animatronic mascots while trapped inside Willy's Wonderland.
detail.tagline: Their idea of fun is killer!
detail.title: Willy's Wonderland
